input.note: nflverse schedules feed. Scores are redistributed from the NFL's own results feed; the official game pages remain the citation.

derivations.margin_home: home_score - away_score, recomputed here, not copied from a `result` column
derivations.push_logic: spread pushes occur when margin_home == market line; totals push when total == market total. Both are counted, never silently dropped.

week9_2026.status_rule: 'absent_from_snapshot' means the committed feed has no result for that game at all (it was compiled before kickoff) and therefore neither agrees nor disagrees. Only 'mismatch' is an error.
week9_2026.note: The committed snapshot was frozen before these games were played; the comparison is therefore a check of the feed I re-fetched in this session, and a documented proof of staleness for the snapshot.

window_note: The 600 most recent settled regular-season games are inlined; every published figure this hub computes states its own n and window.
